title: If
lrc:
[00:19.00] If a picture paints a thousand words
[00:26.46] Then why can't I paint you?
[00:33.04] The words will never show "the you" I've come to know
[00:39.96] If a face could launch a thousand ships
[00:43.56] Then where am I to go?
[00:48.76] There's no one home but you
[00:52.08] You're all that's left me too
[00:58.08] And when my love for life is running dry
[01:07.29] You come and pour yourself on me
[01:16.84] If a man could be two places at one time
[01:24.70] I'd be with you
[01:31.96] Tomorrow and today, beside you all the way
[01:39.12] If the world should stop revolvin', spinnin' slowly down to die
[01:46.28] I'd spend the end with you
[01:51.14] And when the world was through
[01:57.70] Then one by one, the stars would all go out
[02:11.00] Then you and I would simply fly away
